stories.title: Iran lets some countries' ships through Hormuz as Trump threatens more war
stories.body: An Iranian MP said ships from India, China, Iraq and Qatar can pass through the Strait of Hormuz, with Indian and Chinese ships paying transit fees. More than 120 commercial ships have been hit since the war began, with October the worst month. Iran's security chief Mohsen Rezaei met President Putin in Moscow on 5 November with a message from Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei. Iran also sent a new proposal through Qatar, while President Trump said the US may have to "destroy the rest" of Iran.
stories.why: Iran is using access to Hormuz as a diplomatic tool, which keeps supply uncertain and prices high for oil importers.

cards.front: Which countries' ships did Iran say could pass Hormuz in November 2026?
cards.back: India, China, Iraq and Qatar (Indian and Chinese ships paying transit fees, per an Iranian MP).

stories.title: Troops rescue 16 kidnap victims in Niger State
stories.body: The Army said troops of 18 Brigade rescued 16 abductees on 5 November after intercepting suspected terrorists moving from Mashegu LGA towards Kontagora LGA, Niger State. It said two AK-47 rifles, three RPG bombs and 33 motorcycles were recovered. The figures are the Army's own account. The 14 Islamic school pupils abducted in Rafi LGA on 31 October were not reported as rescued.
stories.why: Niger State links the North-west bandit belt to the North-central, which makes it a key kidnapping corridor.

stories.title: Bandits besiege eight communities in Taraba
stories.body: A community leader said suspected bandits have besieged eight communities in Karim-Lamido LGA, Taraba State, near the borders with Plateau and Bauchi. He said 10 of 15 recently abducted residents had been freed, and alleged the gangs operate from forests in Plateau. Police said they had not yet established the details.
stories.why: It shows banditry spreading from the North-west into the North-east and North-central.

stories.title: Democrats win both houses of the US Congress
stories.body: The Democratic Party won control of both the US House of Representatives and the Senate in the 3 November midterm elections. With counting continuing, Democrats had won 228 House seats and 54 Senate seats, according to AP tallies reported by Al Jazeera. Democrats gained seats in states including Texas, Michigan and Kansas. President Trump remains in office until January 2029, but now faces a Congress controlled by the opposition.
stories.why: Congress shapes US aid, sanctions and security cooperation, including with Nigeria and on the wars in Iran and Ukraine.

cards.front: Which party won control of the US House and Senate in the November 2026 midterms?

stories.title: Abu Dhabi talks on Ukraine set for 10–11 November
stories.body: US envoy Steve Witkoff announced US-mediated talks between Russia and Ukraine in Abu Dhabi on 10 and 11 November. The Kremlin said Russia's delegation will be led by Vladimir Medinsky. President Zelenskyy said he hopes the talks open the way to a meeting with President Putin. European governments will not be at the table, but US envoys are meeting Germany, France, the UK, NATO and the EU in Brussels.
stories.why: A deal would ease pressure on world food and fuel prices that affect Nigeria.

cards.front: Who leads Russia's delegation at the November 2026 Abu Dhabi talks?
cards.back: Vladimir Medinsky, a former culture minister.

stories.title: Nigeria starts writing a new National Security Strategy
stories.body: National Security Adviser Nuhu Ribadu inaugurated a 33-member committee to review the 2019 National Security Strategy and draft a new one, NSS 2026. It is chaired by retired Major General Sarkin Bello and must submit a final draft by 27 November. The new strategy is meant to address terrorism, banditry, kidnapping, cybercrime and misinformation.
stories.why: The National Security Strategy is the framework the NIA and other agencies work within, so it is a likely interview question.

cards.front: Which National Security Strategy is Nigeria replacing, and with what?
cards.back: The 2019 NSS, with a new NSS 2026 (committee inaugurated by NSA Ribadu in October 2026).
